title: TED Coordinator – Farming Drive
description:
The TED Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering high-quality farmer and employees’ capacity-building programs across the Maharashtra cluster. The role focuses on strengthening farmer knowledge and adoption of regenerative farming practices through field demonstrations, farmer learning events, hands-on training, and continuous assessment of learning outcomes. The TED coordinator will work closely with field teams, R&D experts, and farmers to improve adoption of regenerative farming practices while ensuring that training content is relevant to the local agro-climatic conditions.

**a. Training Delivery**

i. Plan and conduct farmer training programs, workshops, field schools, and exposure visits.

ii. Deliver practical, hands-on learning through Frontline Demonstrations (FLDs) at farmers' fields.

iii. Customize training modules based on local farming systems and seasonal requirements.

iv. Organise the training need assessment (TNA) in coordination with respective stakeholders, plan and execute the monthly plan as per TNA

v. Promote experiential learning rather than classroom-based instruction.

**b. Technical Support - Provide training and extension support**

i. Regenerative farming practices – Trenching, Bunding, Hedging, Biodiversity integration

ii. Soil health management – Aerobic or Indore method adoption

iii. Fodder production and management – BNH-14 and 11, and Cumbu Napier production

iv. Ensilage and Hay preparation from Napier fodder and relevant fodder ecosystem

v. Organic dairy management – TMR, CMP, CIP, Free housing, calf rearing, importance of EVP,

vi. Beekeeping and pollinator management

vii. Natural resource conservation

viii. Sustainable crop production practices on greens and vegetables

**c. Farmer Engagement**

i. Build strong relationships with farmers and local communities.

ii. Travel extensively across villages to support field demonstrations and follow-up visits.

iii. Identify farmer learning needs and recommend appropriate interventions.

iv. Encourage farmer participation and adoption of improved practices.

**d. Assessment & Documentation**

i. Conduct pre-training and post-training assessments to measure knowledge gain and training effectiveness.

ii. Maintain training records, attendance, assessment reports, and field documentation.

iii. Prepare monthly reports highlighting training activities, adoption levels, challenges, and success stories.

iv. Collect field feedback and continuously improve training content.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum Masters qualification
* Preference will be given to Farming science background

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–10 years of experience in farmer training, agricultural extension, rural development, or capacity-building programs.
* Experience working directly with farming communities is essential.
* Prior experience in regenerative or sustainable agriculture programs will be an advantage.

**Language Requirements**

* Fluent in Marathi (mandatory).
* Good proficiency in Hindi and English.
* Ability to communicate effectively with farmers, field teams, and technical experts

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent oral communication and presentation skills.
* Strong facilitation and adult-learning techniques.
* Ability to identify learning gaps during training and adapt delivery accordingly.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to design and administer pre- and post-training assessments.
* Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills with farmers and stakeholders.
* Comfortable using MS Office and digital tools for documentation and reporting.

**General Requirements**

* Should have Two-wheeler, Helmet along with Vehicle documents, Driving License, and Insurance.
* Should have a smartphone and be able to use and operate all Mobile applications.

**Key Result Area**

- Conduct 48 farmer training programmes

- Train 1,000+ farmer participations

- Implement 24 Frontline Demonstrations (FLDs)

- Conduct 100% pre- and post-training assessments

- Maintain ≥90% participant satisfaction

- Develop 04 farmer success stories

- Submit 100% of reports on time

description: Job DescriptionCiklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer to join our team full-time in India.We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.About The RoleAs a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology** is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. **Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution**

* Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.

* Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.

* Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.

**About Us**

Manna Rubber Products is part of the Manna Group of Companies, a Kerala-based rubber group working in rubber reclaiming, tread rubber and retreading materials, and tires, with operations in India and the UAE. We’re growing our range of compression-molded rubber products, including rubber mats.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced production manager to lead our compression-molded rubber goods production. You’ll run day-to-day production, including planning, people, machines, quality, and reporting, and you’ll be responsible for improving machine and manpower efficiency in ways we can measure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and run daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules against sales orders so orders ship on time at the target quality and cost.
* Manage the full compression molding process: compound issue, preform preparation, press loading, curing (time, temperature, and pressure), deflashing, trimming, inspection, and packing.
* Lead, train, and motivate shift supervisors, operators, and contract workers. This includes manpower allocation, shift planning, discipline, and multi-skilling.
* Measure and report machine efficiency (press utilization, OEE, cycle time, downtime, and changeover losses) and act to improve it.
* Measure and report manpower efficiency (output per man-hour or man-shift, labour cost per piece or kg, overtime and absenteeism).
* Prepare daily production reports and a monthly MIS covering plan vs. actual, OEE, rejection and scrap, material consumption vs. standard, and yield.
* Reduce rejection and rework by finding the root cause of molding defects (under-cure, air traps, short fill, blisters, excess flash) and putting corrective actions in place, working closely with the QC lab.
* Control material consumption, flash and scrap losses, and energy use.
* Make sure production transactions in SAP are accurate: production orders, material issues, receipts and stock.
* Work with maintenance on preventive maintenance of presses, molds and utilities, and with stores, QC and dispatch.
* Enforce safety, 5S and housekeeping standards, including safe operation of hydraulic presses.
* Support new product development, mold trials, SOPs and process sheets.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in compression-molded rubber goods manufacturing, as a production manager or in a related role (Production In-charge, Assistant Production Manager or Plant Manager).
* Strong hands-on knowledge of compression molding presses, curing parameters, mold handling and common molding defects.
* A record of leading and managing large shopfloor teams across shifts.

description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.

BIM/Revit is a must, and experience with healthcare projects is a valuable plus.Key Responsibilities:Lead design development through detailed design and construction documentation, ensuring design intent, quality, and constructability.Create and review plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, and technical drawings; coordinate with structural, MEPF, interiors, and landscape consultants.Manage multidisciplinary coordination, resolve design conflicts, and ensure alignment with project timelines and budgets.Contribute to interior planning, finishes, furniture layouts, and space planning when needed.Present design concepts and progress to clients; lead design reviews and site visits.Mentor junior architects and support QA/QC of project documentation.Drive BIM-based modeling, coordination, and documentation across all disciplines.Requirements:Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent; licensure preferred.8+ years of professional architecture experience with a track record of leading projects.Experience in healthcare architecture is an added advantage.BIM/Revit experience is mandatory; strong capability in multidisciplinary coordination within BIM workflows.Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator/InDesign, 3D visualization/rendering tools, and Microsoft Office.Solid understanding of building planning, construction methods, materials, and detailing; strong design development and documentation skills. Excellent communication, coordination, and project-management abilities; ability to manage multiple deliverables and meet deadlines.Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
